result.title: REViT-v2: Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViT for Equivariant Feature Extraction
result.comment: 7 pages, Accepted for presentation at NeurIPS NeurREPS workshop 2026
result.summary: We propose a scalable roto-reflection-group-equivariant vision transformer based on windowed group-convolutional self-attention and a hierarchical feature architecture. We demonstrate that our approach can be scaled to group-equivariant vision transformers (ViTs) with millions of parameters and large datasets with practically sized images, i.e., ImageNet. The code and pretrained weights for the proposed Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViTs (REViT-v2) are available at https://github.com/kc-ml2/revit.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 REViT-v2，一种基于窗口化群卷积自注意力和层级特征结构的旋转-反射群等变视觉 Transformer，并将其扩展到百万参数规模、在 ImageNet 量级数据上训练，公开代码与预训练权重。
AI.relevance_reason: 属通用等变特征提取，未涉及推理期状态或证据使用；但其窗口化等变注意力与层级表示可能为 LVR 中几何信息保留和 latent 位置/结构偏差的表示设计提供线索，需核查。
